source.name: NHSBSA Open Data — hospital prescribing dispensed in the community
source.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: NHS Business Services Authority.

scope: Items prescribed by an NHS trust in England and dispensed in a community pharmacy. Not in-hospital usage, and not GP prescribing.

rules.product: BNF code characters 1-11; segment 10-11 'AA' is the generic, any other pair is a brand. Where one 11-character code holds presentations whose names do not share a first word (a BNF catch-all such as 'Other emollient preparations'), each 13-character code is its own product. Generics are never split.
rules.label: The product's most common BNF_NAME truncated at its first word that starts with a digit (a digit inside a brand word, as in E45, is kept).
rules.trend: A percentage change is published only where the baseline month is at or above 25 items. Below that the tool prints 'too few to trend' and no number.
